info.title: Corporate Fleet Management - Vehicle States & Maintenance API
info.description: Deterministic RESTful API for vehicle lifecycle, append-only state audits, and maintenance schedules.

get.description: The system shall expose GET /health as a public endpoint returning deterministic status.
The system shall expose GET /vehicles as an admin-only endpoint with stable pagination.

post.description: The system shall expose POST /vehicles as an admin-only endpoint creating vehicle and first AVAILABLE state event.

get.description: The system shall expose GET /vehicles/{vehicle_id} as an admin-only endpoint.

patch.description: The system shall expose PATCH /vehicles/{vehicle_id} as an admin-only endpoint updating supplied fields.

delete.description: The system shall expose DELETE /vehicles/{vehicle_id} as an admin-only endpoint deleting unused vehicle and history.

get.description: The system shall expose GET /vehicles/{vehicle_id}/state as an authenticated endpoint returning latest state.
The system shall expose GET /vehicles/{vehicle_id}/state-history as an admin-only endpoint.

post.description: The system shall expose POST /vehicles/{vehicle_id}/state-transitions as an admin-only endpoint.

get.description: The system shall expose GET /maintenances filtering by owner for non-admin callers.

post.description: The system shall expose POST /maintenances creating a SCHEDULED record.

get.description: The system shall expose GET /maintenances/{maintenance_id} for requester or admin.

403.description: Access denied to other users' maintenance

patch.description: The system shall expose PATCH /maintenances/{maintenance_id} allowing changes only to SCHEDULED records.

409.description: Maintenance not in SCHEDULED status or interval overlap

post.description: The system shall expose POST /maintenances/{maintenance_id}/start moving record to IN_PROGRESS.

409.description: Vehicle not in MAINTENANCE state or maintenance not SCHEDULED

post.description: The system shall expose POST /maintenances/{maintenance_id}/complete moving record to COMPLETED.

409.description: Maintenance not IN_PROGRESS or invalid completion date

post.description: The system shall expose POST /maintenances/{maintenance_id}/cancel moving record to CANCELLED.

409.description: Maintenance is already terminal or invalid cancellation date
